        self,
        *,
        signal_id: str,
        symbol: str,
        side: OrderSide,
        quote_amount: Decimal | None,
        sell_quantity: Decimal | None,
        correlation_id: str,
    ) -> ExecutionResult:
        """Execute the order through the configured trading mode."""
        if self._settings.is_live_trading_active:
            if self._live_execution_service is None:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Live trading is enabled but no live execution service was configured"
                )
            result = await self._live_execution_service.execute(
                signal_id=signal_id,
                symbol=symbol,
                side=side,
                quote_amount=quote_amount,
                sell_quantity=sell_quantity,
                correlation_id=correlation_id,
            )
            return ExecutionResult(order=result.order, trade=result.trade)

        paper_result = await self._paper_execution_service.execute(
            signal_id=signal_id,
            symbol=symbol,
            side=side,
            quote_amount=quote_amount,
            sell_quantity=sell_quantity,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
        )
        return ExecutionResult(order=paper_result.order, trade=paper_result.trade)
module_source:
"""Selects and invokes the appropriate execution service (paper or live)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from app.config.settings import Settings
from app.domain.enums import OrderSide, OrderStatus
from app.domain.orders import Order
from app.domain.trades import Trade
from app.services.live_execution_service import LiveExecutionService
from app.services.paper_execution_service import PaperExecutionService


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ExecutionResult:
    """Unified result shape regardless of which execution path ran."""

    order: Order
    trade: Trade | None


class OrderService:
    """Dispatches execution to paper or live services based on configuration.

    Live execution only ever runs when both ``trading_mode=live`` and
    ``live_trading_enabled=True`` (see ``Settings.is_live_trading_active``).
    This is the single gate between the webhook pipeline and real money.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: Settings,
        paper_execution_service: PaperExecutionService,
        live_execution_service: LiveExecutionService | None,
    ) -> None:
        self._settings = settings
        self._paper_execution_service = paper_execution_service
        self._live_execution_service = live_execution_service

    async def execute(
        self,
        *,
        signal_id: str,
        symbol: str,
        side: OrderSide,
        quote_amount: Decimal | None,
        sell_quantity: Decimal | None,
        correlation_id: str,
    ) -> ExecutionResult:
        """Execute the order through the configured trading mode."""
        if self._settings.is_live_trading_active:
            if self._live_execution_service is None:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Live trading is enabled but no live execution service was configured"
                )
            result = await self._live_execution_service.execute(
                signal_id=signal_id,
                symbol=symbol,
                side=side,
                quote_amount=quote_amount,
                sell_quantity=sell_quantity,
                correlation_id=correlation_id,
            )
            return ExecutionResult(order=result.order, trade=result.trade)

        paper_result = await self._paper_execution_service.execute(
            signal_id=signal_id,
            symbol=symbol,
            side=side,
            quote_amount=quote_amount,
            sell_quantity=sell_quantity,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
        )
        return ExecutionResult(order=paper_result.order, trade=paper_result.trade)

    @staticmethod
    def is_successful(result: ExecutionResult) -> bool:
        """Return True if the resulting order is not in a failed/uncertain state."""
        return result.order.status not in (
            OrderStatus.FAILED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.UNCERTAIN,
        )
